title: I Lose Myself in Love
program_note:
I Lose Myself in Love was written for Vox Primera, at the request of Danaë Vlasse.  The text is drawn from the prose work Jawhar Al Dhat by the late 12th to early 13th century Sufi mystic Attar of Nishapur, also known as Farid-Ud-Din.  (The text was assembled with the kind help of Shahab Paranj).  Focusing on love, it ultimately depicts spiritual self-annihilation.

The composition is approximately five minutes in duration.

David S. Lefkowitz
Los Angeles, CA
5 January, 2020
